name: OpenLeverage
fix_description: Add initializer modifier (from OpenZeppelin Initializable) to the initialize function. Without it, anyone can call initialize repeatedly to overwrite admin and distributor, taking control of the contract.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward uninitialized/incorrectly protected initialize() takeover leading to admin hijack, implementation change, and delegatecall-based token draining. The attack flow is short and obvious, with no flash loans, pricing logic, or deep protocol-specific reasoning required.
